info.title: Forma Zieleni Core API
info.description: Current-tree Core API contract. Source of truth for visitor lead qualification, staff Opportunity/Offer/Contract/Project create/list/get. Legacy OpenAPI under legacy/ is reference only.

servers.description: Local or lab origin. Host, port and scheme are not a production hosting decision.

tags.name: Capacity
tags.description: Staff availability windows. No external calendar and no customer fields.

tags.name: SiteIntelligence
tags.description: RULES-derived site constraints and opportunities. Synthetic observations only; no live Geoportal credentials or AI conclusions.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Provider-neutral payment schedules. No money movement.

200.description: Process is accepting local health checks.

get.description: Readiness for the current API dependencies. This is not liveness.

200.description: Required dependencies accept a trivial check.

post.description: Public visitor capture. Server-side validation and rate limits apply. Object authorization is enforced on later reads.

200.description: Cursor page of leads visible to the caller.
Lead visible to the authorized caller.

get.description: Published projection is public. A draft requires a server-granted content:read-draft capability. Client-supplied role, capabilities, or actorId are rejected. This is not a CRM object.
Lists synthetic Agnieszka approval proposals. Requires semantic:review. Does not authorize spend, price, or live publication.

post.description: Reviews a synthetic proposal (edit / approve / partial / reject / defer). Cannot override Owner, spend, price, or live publication gates.
Compiles a synthetic marketing plan from a goal, a budget ceiling and a horizon. The plan does not authorize spend or publication. Requires the server-granted growth:plan capability.

201.description: Synthetic plan. Not a business result and not permission to spend.

post.description: Staff create an Opportunity only from a qualified Lead. Status is assigned by the domain; callers must not supply a status machine.

200.description: Cursor page of opportunities visible to the caller.
Opportunity visible to the authorized caller.

post.description: Staff create an Offer only from an existing Opportunity. Status is assigned by the domain; callers must not supply price or a status machine.

200.description: Cursor page of offers visible to the caller.
Offer visible to the authorized caller.

post.description: Staff create a Contract only from an existing Offer. Status is assigned by the domain; callers must not supply signing provider or lifecycle fields.

200.description: Cursor page of contracts visible to the caller.
Contract visible to the authorized caller.

post.description: Staff advance provider-neutral Contract lifecycle (draft → internal_review → approved → sent). No signing vendor, QES claim, payment, or webhook fields.
Staff create a Project only from an existing Contract. Status is assigned by the domain; callers must not supply payment provider or lifecycle fields.

200.description: Cursor page of projects visible to the caller.
Project visible to the authorized caller.

get.description: Staff list provider-neutral payment schedules. No provider, charge, or card fields.

post.description: Staff create a provider-neutral payment schedule on a draft Contract. Synthetic amounts only. No PSP.

put.description: Staff replace installment lines while contract is draft and all lines are scheduled.

post.description: Staff advance installment status without moving money or calling a payment provider.
Staff create a Przelewy24 sandbox intent for a due installment. No outbound provider call and no production key.
Confirm a sandbox installment from a signed webhook. A bad signature does not change schedule status. No live charge.

200.description: Schedule after a valid sandbox confirmation.

get.description: Staff read the Documenso sandbox envelope for a contract. No token is returned.

post.description: Staff open a Documenso sandbox envelope for a sent contract. No outbound call, no API token, and no QES.
Complete a Documenso sandbox envelope from a signed webhook. A bad signature does not change status. No QES.

200.description: Envelope after a valid sandbox completion.

post.description: Staff marks a planned Project delivered so a Garden record may link to it. Empty body only; no payment or provider fields.

get.description: Staff list of capacity windows. Public and portal clients are not authorized.

post.description: Create a staff capacity window. Idempotent. Rejects calendar and customer fields.
Decide whether a promised instant sits inside recorded capacity. Does not write a promise.

200.description: Capacity decision. A refusal is a successful response.

get.description: Staff list of Garden domain records. Not a twin, XR, or plant-advice surface.

post.description: Staff create a Garden linked to a delivered Project. Rejects twin/live/sensor invent fields.

get.description: Client-safe Garden projection for the authenticated portal subject. BOLA via clientSubject.
Staff list of Site Intelligence domain records produced from RULES over synthetic normalized observations.

200.description: Cursor page of site intelligence records.

post.description: Staff create Site Intelligence from synthetic normalized observations via RULES. Rejects AI invent, credentials, twin, and live crawl fields.

get.description: Client-safe Site Intelligence projection for the authenticated portal subject. BOLA via clientSubject.

200.description: Cursor page of portal site intelligence projections.

OpaqueId.description: Non-guessable identifier. Sequential integers are rejected.

PublicLeadSource.description: Caller-asserted source on the unauthenticated capture route. Internal channels are assigned by the server, not by public input.

OpportunityStatus.description: Domain-owned Opportunity status. Callers cannot supply or advance the status machine on create.

OfferStatus.description: Domain-owned Offer status. Callers cannot supply or advance the status machine on create.

clientSubject.description: Optional portal client subject authorized to read a client-safe projection

ContractStatus.description: Domain-owned Contract lifecycle status. Create assigns draft; staff advance via lifecycle endpoint.

ContractLifecycleAdvance.description: Next lifecycle status only. Payment, signing provider, and QES fields are forbidden.

ProjectStatus.description: Domain-owned Project status. Callers cannot supply payment provider or lifecycle on create. delivered unlocks Garden OS linkage only.

clientSubject.description: Optional portal client subject binding set by staff on create.
Portal client subject authorized to read a client-safe projection. Null means staff-only.

PaymentInstallmentInput.description: Synthetic installment line. Provider and charge fields forbidden.

PaymentInstallmentTransition.description: Installment status only. No charge, card, or provider fields.

PaymentSchedule.description: Provider-neutral payment schedule. No PSP fields.

SandboxPaymentIntent.description: Sandbox intent. No secret and no production merchant key.

SigningSandboxEnvelope.description: Local Documenso sandbox envelope. No token and no QES.

ProjectDeliver.description: Empty body. Callers cannot supply status, payment, or provider fields.

CapacityWindowCreate.description: Staff capacity window. No calendar provider and no customer fields.

Garden.description: Garden OS domain record. Not a twin database, sensor feed, or live garden invent.

PortalGardenProjection.description: Client-safe garden projection. Omits clientSubject and any twin/live invent fields.

SiteIntelligenceRecord.description: Site Intelligence domain record from RULES. Not an AI conclusion, twin, or live Geoportal payload.

PortalSiteIntelligenceProjection.description: Client-safe site intelligence projection. Omits clientSubject and any AI/credential invent fields.

Forbidden.description: Caller is authenticated but not authorized for this object.

NotFound.description: Object does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: Idempotency key reused with a different body.

Unavailable.description: A required dependency is not ready. The body does not include connection or query details.
